
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- main.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- CONCURRENCY -- main.volt:9[/yellow bold]

Variable `mixed_val` is shared between isr_task (critical) and bg_task. Each read and write is atomic in the generated C.

 [dim]8 |[/dim] 
 [dim]9 |[/dim] var mixed_val = 0
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]    ^^^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: An update spread over several statements can still interleave; keep it in one statement or use a channel.[/cyan]
